Mod.Name: All Magic Per Character
Mod.Author: BreDoyliesSea
Mod.Description:
Each character can hold every spell in the game at once, up to 100 each.
• Magic storage goes from 32 slots to 64 per character. • Every magic list pages through all of them: magic menu, draw, refine, junction and auto-junction, item and exchange screens. • Draw, cast, junction bonuses, party swaps and battle use all 64 slots. • The extra magic is kept inside your normal save, and existing saves are converted when loaded. A save made with the mod needs the mod to load its magic correctly.
Requires the Steam 2013 English release (FF8_EN.exe). Not for the Remastered edition, other languages or the 2000 release.
